messages:
Sasha: Heads-up — I'll be shadowing the weekend on-call with Kai (Sat/Sun). Who's slated primary/secondary? We still have the billing write errors flapping; want to make sure pager coverage and handoff are clear. cc @Maria @Jon

devops-bot: [Incident INC-472] New alerts: billing-write-errors, rate 3/min. Severity P2. Pager dispatched to @primary.

Maria: I can take primary Sat 09:00–16:00. Leo can do evening 16:00–00:00. There's a gap 02:00–04:00 where we currently have no secondary assigned — likely from the legacy rota.

Jon: I can cover the overnight 00:00–08:00 window as secondary if that helps. Quick reminder: handoff checklist is in the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-handoffs — especially the escalation matrix and PD playbook.

Sasha: perfect — Jon, can you be on rotation for 00:00–08:00? Kai will be shadowing me; primary is responsible for accepting pages.

Kai: noted. I'll shadow the first shift with Sasha and sit on the PD console with them. If pages spike >5/min for billing-write-errors escalate to infra-incident (see runbook).

oncall-sre: Handoff checklist (short):
1) Confirm PagerDuty rotation matches calendar.
2) Verify runbook open and accessible.
3) Smoke test key endpoints.
4) Post handoff note in this thread with confirmed times and who owns the page.

Maria: smoke test snippet for billing write path:```bash
curl -s -X POST \"https://billing-api.internal.redwood/v2/write\" -d '{"test":true}' | jq .
```Expect 200 + {"ok":true}. If 5xx or latency >2s, start mitigation playbook A.

Leo: I'll take 16:00–00:00. Adding a calendar event now. 

ops-manager: FYI for customer impact assessment — INC-472 affects writes for a subset on the v2 billing pipeline (customers on shard-7). Estimated degraded throughput ~30% during spikes. Please capture affected customers list in postmortem if escalation occurs.

Jon: I'll take 00:00–08:00 as secondary. Can someone confirm PD escalation policy for P2 during weekend? Do we call the on-call manager after 30m of unresolved P2?

oncall-sre: Policy: P2 — page primary, wait 15m. If no ack or ongoing customer-impact >15m escalate to secondary. If >30m or partial outage, call on-call manager (+1). Full policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/policies/pagerduty-escalation

Sasha: schedule check — can we do a 20–30m pre-shift H2H on Saturday 09:15 so I can run Kai through the checklist and PD UI?

Leo: 09:15 works for me.

Maria: Added to calendar, note pinned to event: "Handoff + shadowing checklist runthrough".

Kai: One quick question — for a mitigation that requires a model fallback (e.g., downgrade to quantized variant), who's authorized to flip the route? I remember there was an auto-fallback but manual can be triggered.

oncall-sre: Auto-fallback exists for capacity flaps. Manual model routing changes require primary + one senior eng sign-off (or use the emergency toggle in Console). If you're shadowing, just notify primary and let them drive.

Sasha: copying final rota here so it's explicit: Maria primary 09:00–16:00, Leo primary 16:00–00:00, Jon secondary 00:00–08:00, Kai shadowing with Sasha. Overnight gap 02:00–04:00 covered by Jon as secondary.

devops-bot: [Incident INC-472] Alert rate now 1/min. Monitoring.

Sasha: thanks all — I'll run the checklist with Kai Sat 09:15 and post a short confirmation after handoff. If anyone needs to swap, shout here ASAP. :thumbsup:

Jon: :thumbsup: see you Sat.

Maria: Thanks — appreciate the clear handoff.

ops-manager: Good plan. Please file a brief shadowing note in the onboarding tracker after Sat (who did what, any gaps). Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/oncall/onboarding-tracker

Sasha: will do, I'll include a quick itemized post-incident assessment if INC-472 wakes up again
